1.0.0: Initial release: List Workers, Find Workers, Get Worker, List Direct Reports, List Supervisory Organizations, List Supervisory Organization Workers, Run WQL Query, Run Report (RaaS) and Make API Call. Authentication with an API Client for Integrations and a refresh token.

List and Find components read every page of the result. Workers carry their current staffing information (work email, business title, supervisory organization, location); Find Workers filters by email, supervisory organization, location and status; Get Worker can resolve the line manager; List Supervisory Organizations can add the superior organization of each one; Run WQL Query returns results larger than 10,000 rows in full.
